nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
events {
	worker_connections 768;
}

http {
	sendfile on;
	include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
	# access_log /var/log/nginx/commented-out.log;
	log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
	                '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" '
	                '"$http_user_agent" "$http_x_forwarded_for"';
	log_format timed escape=json '{"t":"$time_local","rt":$request_time,"xff":"$http_x_forwarded_for"}';
	access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;
	error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;
	include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
	include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/mime.types:
types {
    text/html                             html htm shtml;
    text/css                              css;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/blog:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name blog.example.com www.blog.example.com;
    root /var/www/blog;
    index index.php;
    access_log /var/log/nginx/blog.access.log main;
    location ~ \.php$ {
        include snippets/fastcgi-php.conf;
        fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.2-fpm.sock;
    }
    location /private/ { auth_basic "Staff"; auth_basic_user_file /etc/nginx/.htpasswd; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/docs:
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    listen [::]:80 default_server;
    server_name docs.example.com _;
    root /var/www/docs;
    location / { try_files $uri $uri/ =404; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app:
server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name app.example.com;
    access_log /var/log/nginx/app.log timed;
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
        proxy_set_header Authorization "Bearer not-a-real-token-0000";
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/quiet:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name quiet.example.com;
    access_log off;
    root /srv/quiet;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/wild:
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name *.shop.example.com;
    root "/var/www/shop";
    access_log /var/log/nginx/$host.log;
}
